hook: Michael Mann’s 1995 film Heat faces a legal battle over who owns the screenplay rights.

sections.voiceover: Michael Mann’s 1995 film Heat faces a legal battle over who owns the screenplay rights.
In 2026, Mann served 3 termination notices to New Regency to reclaim his original work. Will the court grant his request?
However, New Regency claims the screenplay is a work-for-hire, which legally blocks Mann’s ownership claim.
Yariv Milchan filed this lawsuit in the United States District Court for the Central District. The court must resolve this dispute before filming for Heat 2 starts in January 2027.
New Regency and Mann now await a court ruling on the future of the franchise.
